site.name: Linga Bhairavi Apartment
site.tagline: Single rooms with attached kitchen and toilet
site.description: 24 single rooms, each with an attached kitchen and toilet. Rent ₹12,000–₹14,000 including water and repairs. Two-month deposit, six-month minimum stay.

contact.whatsappMessage: Hello, I saw the Linga Bhairavi Apartment website and would like more details about the rooms.

overview.heading: A home away from home
paragraphs: Linga Bhairavi Apartment has 24 single rooms, each with its own attached toilet and kitchen.
This is not a PG. Each room is rented to singles who can make it a home away from home. A maximum of two people can stay in a room.

rooms.heading: Rooms, photos and videos
rooms.intro: Rooms are located at the front, middle and back of the building. The corner rooms are slightly bigger and have an additional window.

rent.heading: Rent and bills
rent.headline: ₹12,000 – ₹14,000 per month
rent.sub: Single room with kitchen and toilet. Corner rooms are slightly bigger and have an additional window.

items.label: Included in rent
items.text: Water bills and all repair costs during the tenancy, including plumbing, electrical and carpentry repairs.

items.label: Paid separately
items.text: Electricity. Each room has its own meter, and tenants pay for the units used as per the meter.

items.label: Refund
items.text: The deposit is returned at the end of the tenancy, after deductions for cleaning and painting.

items.label: Deduction
items.text: ₹7,000 is deducted from the deposit for cleaning and painting.

items.label: Settlement
items.text: The remaining amount is settled within a week of vacating.

facilities.heading: Room facilities
items: Attached kitchen, semi-furnished, with a small kitchen cabinet
Water inlet and outlet for a washing machine (tenants may install their own)
facilities.wifi: Wi-Fi is not provided. Tenants can arrange their own connection.

items.label: Parking
items.text: Bike parking on the ground floor.

items.label: Terrace
items.text: Tenants can use the terrace for drying clothes and short walks.

items.label: Minimum stay
items.text: 6 months. Rooms are not rented for shorter periods. Early exit is possible by mutual understanding between tenant and owner.

items.label: Notice period
items.text: Tenants can vacate within 30 days of giving notice.

items.label: Guests
items.text: ₹100 per day for overnight guests. Tenants keep track of guest days and pay the charges along with that month's rent.

items.label: House rules
items.text: There are no specific restrictions. We expect tenants and their guests to stay calm and not disturb neighbours.

cleaning.heading: Cleaning and repairs
cleaning.text: After each tenancy, the room, toilet and kitchen are professionally cleaned. All repairs are completed before the next tenancy begins.

location.heading: Location and contact
location.busStop: Thubarahalli bus stop, about 0.5 km away.
location.address: 2nd Cross, Meenakshi Layout, opposite Sumadhura Lake Breeze Apartments, Varthur Road
location.availability: Contact the owner to check availability.

faq.a: ₹12,000 to ₹14,000 per month. Water and repairs are included; electricity is billed as per your room's meter.

faq.q: How much is the deposit, and do I get it back?
faq.a: Two months' rent. It is returned at the end of the tenancy after a ₹7,000 deduction for cleaning and painting, and settled within a week of vacating.

faq.q: Do I need to pay anything besides rent?
faq.a: Electricity as per your room's meter, and ₹100 per day for overnight guests.

faq.q: Is there a meter for the room?
faq.a: Yes. Each room has its own electricity meter.
Attached kitchen (with cabinet) and toilet (with geyser), a bed without mattress, a study table and a two-door cupboard with mirror.

faq.q: Is there parking and a lift?
faq.a: Bike parking is on the ground floor, and the building has a lift.

faq.q: Where is the nearest bus stop?

faq.a: No specific restrictions. Please keep noise down and respect the neighbours.

faq.q: Can I see photos and videos of the rooms?
faq.a: Yes, see the Rooms section above, or ask on WhatsApp.
